description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bifur.
When Bifur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Bifur enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Bifur trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
